name: Ta Liang Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Ta Liang Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor inspection products, PCB routing and drilling machines, resin panel cutters, CNC engraving and milling machines, and glass panel processing machines. The company provides PCB routing machines for various applications, including optical modules, mini LED, semiconductor fixtures, mobile phone rigid PCBs, rigid-flex PCBs, and BGA substrates; and PCB drilling machines for AI servo PCB, communication PCB, satellite communication PCB, and vehicle PCB applications. It also offers film plotters; automated edge coating machines; and metrology series, AOI series-wafer level/panel level package, AOI series-die level pack…
